structured_output.analysis: Only iso_3.15 has been measured (kl=0.43614466651129274, E514ab09c524e), and it sits almost at the budget limit. It came from the knapsack, so single-layer same-bit swaps are unlikely to help. I read the tabled moves' positive predicted_delta values as predicted KL increases, not gains, though the analysis does not define the sign. I therefore did not propose them. The method options are unexplored because the base uses defaults, so three proposals test zero-bit GPTQ options: act_order and damp in both directions. The fourth tests whether group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 frees enough bits for two upgrades with large measured single-layer gains. Its budget fit is my estimate and assumes stored scale bits shrink with group size, so it could be refused or its coarser groups could cost more KL than the upgrades recover. The quip_e8p record E111111111111 in one retrieved document was not used, because quip_e8p is not an available method and it does not appear in that layer's table.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_act_order
proposals.rationale: Keeps the per-layer methods of iso_3.15, measured at kl=0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e] with default options, and tests weight_algo.act_order=true across the GPTQ family. No effect of this option has been measured yet.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp_low
proposals.rationale: Keeps the per-layer methods of iso_3.15, measured at kl=0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e] with default options, and tests the lower setting weight_algo.damp=0.005 across the GPTQ family. No effect of this option has been measured yet.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_damp_high
proposals.rationale: Keeps the per-layer methods of iso_3.15, measured at kl=0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e] with default options, and tests the higher setting weight_algo.damp=0.05 across the GPTQ family, bracketing the low-damp proposal. No effect of this option has been measured yet.

proposals.name: iso_3.15_int3_g256_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Sets weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 to try to pay for two upgrades from base iso_3.15, measured at kl=0.43614466651129274 [E514ab09c524e]. Single-layer KL for layers.14 down_proj is 0.00633466 with rht_gptq_int2 [E4c3f9b73e065] and 0.00181478 with rht_gptq_int3 [E90bd4b2f3645]. Single-layer KL for layers.2 up_proj is 0.00641875 with gptq_int3 [E9baa10763ebe] and 0.00237045 with gptq_int4 [Ef3d9c7b4502c]. Those records use default options, and the effect of the group-size change has not been measured.
